intro: Support your breastfeeding journey naturally with Dugadh Dhara Powder, an Ayurvedic formulation specially crafted for new and nursing mothers. Made with carefully selected herbal ingredients, this wellness powder is designed to support healthy milk production while promoting overall maternal well-being during the postnatal period.

In addition to supporting lactation, Dugadh Dhara Powder helps nourish the body after childbirth, maintain energy levels, and provide essential nutritional support during breastfeeding. Its gentle Ayurvedic formulation complements a balanced diet and healthy lifestyle, making it a trusted choice for mothers seeking natural wellness support.
Easy to prepare and pleasant to consume, Dugadh Dhara Powder can be incorporated into your daily routine to support both mother and baby throughout the breastfeeding journey.

li: Helps nourish the body during the postnatal period
Supports strength, energy, and overall wellness
Made with carefully selected Ayurvedic herbal ingredients
Helps meet increased nutritional needs during breastfeeding

p: Mix the recommended quantity of Dugadh Dhara Powder with warm milk or water and consume as directed by your healthcare professional or according to the product label. For best results, use regularly as part of a balanced diet and healthy lifestyle.
Net Quantity: 400 gSuitable For: Breastfeeding & Nursing Mothers

full: Dugadh Dhara Powder – Ayurvedic Lactation Support for Breastfeeding Mothers
